The workflows in this repository try to follow existing, basic samples with little customization.

## main.yml
We use a standard dotnet build/test/pack workflow  
https://docs.github.com/en/actions/automating-builds-and-tests/building-and-testing-net

- Build the solution using the dotnet cli
  - Strong name the assemblies using a key stored in the repository  
    https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/project/strong-name-signing.md
- Test the built libraries
  - In a PR run, only local tests are run.
  - In a CI run, live tests are run using a repository secret containing an OpenAI token  
    https://docs.github.com/en/actions/security-guides/using-secrets-in-github-actions
- Package the built libraries
- Publish the package to a GitHub NuGet registry  
  https://docs.github.com/en/packages/working-with-a-github-packages-registry/working-with-the-nuget-registry
- Publish a single build artifact containing test results and a nuget package

## release.yml
Releases are triggered by publishing a release in the GitHub repository.  The release workflow will:

- Build the solution using the dotnet cli
  - Strong name the assemblies using a key stored in the repository  
- Test the built libraries
  - Live tests are run using a repository secret containing an OpenAI token  
- Package the built libraries
- Publish the package to public NuGet registry  
- Publish a single build artifact containing test results and a nuget package

## openai-spec-sync.md
An agentic workflow, authored for [gh-aw](https://github.com/github/gh-aw) as markdown and compiled
to `openai-spec-sync.lock.yml`.  Runs monthly on the 2nd at 03:00 America/Los_Angeles, and can be
started manually from the Actions tab.

- A deterministic step runs `scripts/Sync-OpenAISpec.ps1`, which downloads the OpenAI REST API
  specification, stops early when the content is unchanged, rotates the previous snapshot aside, and
  runs the vendored processor in `specification/tools/` to split the specification into
  per-feature specifications and generate a structural diff report.
- An agent then reads the diff report and writes the human-facing analysis.
- The pull request is opened through gh-aw safe outputs, so the agent itself has no write access.

Manual runs accept `source_ref` to snapshot a specific upstream ref, `force` to process even when
the content is unchanged, and `dry_run` to publish the results as an artifact without opening a
pull request.  The same script backs local runs; see `specification/tools/README.md`.

Editing this workflow means editing the markdown and re-running `gh aw compile`; the `.lock.yml`
is generated and should not be hand-edited.  Compiling also emits `agentics-maintenance.yml`, a
gh-aw scheduled cleanup workflow for expiring safe outputs.  It is generated rather than authored,
and it is regenerated by the same command.

## agentic-lockfile-check.yml
Runs on pull requests that touch an agentic workflow markdown source or its compiled lock file.

- Installs the pinned `gh-aw` extension, re-runs `gh aw compile --strict`, and fails if anything
  it generates differs from what is committed.

GitHub Actions runs the lock file rather than the markdown, so an edit that was never recompiled
would change nothing and warn about nothing.  This check makes that divergence visible at review
time.  The pinned version lives in the `gh_aw_version` environment variable and should be kept in
step with the version used locally.

## spec-tooling-checks.yml
Runs on pull requests that touch the specification processing tooling, the TypeSpec folder set, or
the sync script.

- Runs the `OpenAI.SpecProcessor.Tests` suite, which covers diff idempotence, the YAML repair, the
  feature area routing rules, unassigned path reporting, and reference closure validation.

The code integrity checks deliberately ignore `specification/tools/**` and `specification/openai/**`,
since a snapshot has nothing to say about code generation, so the tool needs a check of its own.
One of those tests compares the feature area map against the folder set under
`specification/base/typespec`, which is why a change to that folder set also triggers this workflow.
